name: ilife
description: 爱生活全 TS 重构（一期框架）monorepo

scripts.build: tsc -b && node packages/skill-calorie/scripts/gen-cli.mjs --stamp && node packages/skill-bill/scripts/gen-cli.mjs --stamp && pnpm -r --if-present run build:client
scripts.gen: node packages/skill-calorie/scripts/gen-cli.mjs && node packages/skill-bill/scripts/gen-cli.mjs && node packages/skill-chef/scripts/gen-cli.mjs && node tooling/skill-call-form.mjs
scripts.gen:check: node packages/skill-calorie/scripts/gen-cli.mjs --check && node packages/skill-bill/scripts/gen-cli.mjs --check && node packages/skill-chef/scripts/gen-cli.mjs --check && node tooling/skill-call-form.mjs --check
scripts.gate:selftest: node tooling/run-locked.mjs --ticket selftest --lock-dir .scratch/locks-selftest -- node --test tooling/test/run-locked.test.mjs tooling/test/check-gate-audit.test.mjs
